gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai is friendly and plain, with lowercase puffed up like glass beads. Bushcraft sits above it with extra-wide spacing and curves that never swell or thin, so the heading feels hand-made while the body stays rounded, open and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-vithku: Expressive Bushcraft spreads its letters wide, with capitals barely taller than lowercase. Noto Sans Vithkuqi follows as a plain sans with open throats on a, c, e and s, so a long passage moves along smoothly and with very little fuss.
